A Bayesian network meta-analysis was performed using
ADDIS software, which allows the intercomparison of
different color illuminations. Due to inconsistent methods
with which to quantify emotions, the raw data were extracted
and then normalized. Standardized mean differences (SMD)
were used for effect size merging, and their 95% confidence
intervals were calculated. Study heterogeneity was judged
using the I2 statistic, with I2 ≤ 50% indicating acceptable

As the function of light continues to be explored, in addition to basic lighting, it is
also used in areas such as communications, display and medical. In the medical field,
people try to use light to make people healthier and even therapeutic effects, mood
disorders are typical of diseases that benefit from lighting therapy. Emotions are
modifiable and are manifested in any process of change in the onset, offset, amplitude,
and duration of emotional states. The ability of light, as a typical external environmental
stimulus, to modulate mood has been demonstrated by several disciplines. In the
process of practical application, there are still some problems: 1) contradictory research
findings on the short-term effects of light on mood, and consistent conclusions on mood
regulation cannot yet be obtained on parameters such as light intensity and spectrum;
2) no differences in the mood regulation settings of light on people with different
psychological states, and strong and super-intense light abuse; 3) unknown quantitative
effects of light for mood disorders, small sample size of studies, and still using visual
parameters to quantify light in non-visual functions, etc., and lack of accurate light-
emotion regulation mapping models.

摘要
随着对灯光功能的不断挖掘，除了基础照明以外，光在通信、显示以及医疗
等领域也得到了应用。在医疗领域，人们尝试使用光照让人变得更健康甚至达到
治疗作用，情绪障碍就是典型的从照明疗法获益的疾病。情绪具有可调节性，表
现在情绪状态的开始、偏移、幅度、持续时间变化的各个过程。光照作为典型的
外部环境刺激，对情绪的调节能力已经得到多个学科的证明。在实际应用过程中，
依然存在一些问题：1）光照对情绪的短时影响研究结论存在矛盾，尚不能在光
照强度和光谱等参数上获得情绪调节的一致结论；2）对不同心理状态人群的情
绪调节设置的光照无差异，强光、超强光滥用；3）光治疗情绪障碍量效不明，
研究样本量小，依然采用视觉参数量化非视觉功能中的光照等，缺少准确的光照
-情绪调节映射模型。
针对上述问题，本文的研究内容如下：

理论基础，对现有情绪研究中的视觉光参数进行非视觉参数值转化，进一步的，

also used in areas such as communications, display and medical. In the medical field,
people try to use light to make people healthier and even therapeutic effects, mood
disorders are typical of diseases that benefit from lighting therapy. Emotions are
modifiable and are manifested in any process of change in the onset, offset, amplitude,
and duration of emotional states. The ability of light, as a typical external environmental
stimulus, to modulate mood has been demonstrated by several disciplines. In the
process of practical application, there are still some problems: 1) contradictory research
findings on the short-term effects of light on mood, and consistent conclusions on mood
regulation cannot yet be obtained on parameters such as light intensity and spectrum;
2) no differences in the mood regulation settings of light on people with different
psychological states, and strong and super-intense light abuse; 3) unknown quantitative
effects of light for mood disorders, small sample size of studies, and still using visual
parameters to quantify light in non-visual functions, etc., and lack of accurate light-
emotion regulation mapping models.
